numbering: Episodes numbered continuously across seasons: Season 1 is 1-11, Season 2 is 12-24 and Season 3 is 25-35 (Anime Filler Guide numbering).

arcs.name: Mother and Children
arcs.summary: A rural doctor and his dying patient are reborn as the twin children of their favorite idol, Ai Hoshino, who is secretly a mother.
events: Gorou is murdered by a stalker and reborn as Aquamarine, while Sarina is reborn as Ruby.
The twins grow up watching Ai become a top star.
Ai is stabbed to death at her front door by a fan who knew her address.
Aqua swears revenge on their unknown father, whom he believes tipped off the killer.

arcs.name: Sweet Today
arcs.summary: In high school, Aqua enters show business to hunt for clues and reunites with child-actress Kana Arima on a cheap manga-based drama.
events: Ruby and Aqua enroll at Youtou High's entertainment course.
Aqua and Kana salvage a poorly made drama with a single strong scene.

arcs.name: Reality Dating Show
arcs.summary: Aqua joins a romance reality show to get closer to a director, and a fellow cast member is caught up in an online hate campaign.
events: Akane Kurokawa is harassed online after an edited clip makes her look bad.
Aqua stops Akane from attempting suicide and helps clear her name.
Akane copies Ai's personality perfectly, alarming Aqua.

arcs.name: B Komachi
arcs.summary: Ruby revives her mother's idol group, B Komachi, with Kana and the influencer MEM-cho.
events: Kana reluctantly joins Ruby's group.
B Komachi performs at the Japan Idol Festival.

arcs.name: Tokyo Blade
arcs.summary: Aqua, Kana and Akane are cast in a 2.5D stage play adapting a hit manga, and the production clashes with the original author's wishes.
events: The play's script is rewritten after the original manga's author objects.
Aqua uses his trauma as an actor to deliver a strong performance.
Aqua learns more about the man he believes is his father.

arcs.name: Private (Miyazaki)
arcs.summary: B Komachi travels to Miyazaki to film a music video near the hospital where the twins were born.
events: Ruby discovers Gorou's remains.
Ruby takes up Aqua's quest for revenge.

arcs.name: Scandal
arcs.summary: As Ruby's career takes off, a tabloid scandal threatens the group.
events: Ruby shows a darker, more driven side.
Kana is caught in a scandal and Aqua makes a hard choice.

arcs.name: 15 Years of Lies
arcs.summary: Aqua sets out to make a film about Ai's life and death.
events: Casting for the film begins.
Ruby auditions for the role of Ai.
Filming of Ai's story begins.

filler.note: No filler: every episode adapts the manga.
